schemaxis.ngspice/1.scope: Only named cases, recorded runtimes and tested lifecycle paths. No MPI or exhaustive operation qualification.

cases.scope: Resistive divider: Vout=Vsource*2000/(1000+2000); expected endpoint 10/3 V.
Equal resistors give Vout=Vsource/2, independent of the native solver.
At omega*RC=1, H=1/(1+j)=(1-j)/2. At twice cutoff H=(1-2j)/5; analytic magnitude and phase.
Doubling C doubles omega*RC at fixed frequency: H=1/(1+2j).
Initially uncharged first-order capacitor: Vout(t)=5*(1-exp(-t/0.001)); five time constants at the endpoint.
Doubling R doubles RC and duration needed to reach the same five-time-constant endpoint.
Balanced bridge of equal resistors has Vleft=Vright=Vsource/2 and zero bridge voltage.
Two equal RC stages have Hout=1/(1+3sRC+(sRC)^2). At omega*RC=1, Vout=-j/3 and Vmid=(1-j)/3.

The signed divider remains linear from -5 V to zero. Literal endpoints check polarity and zero crossing; sample-coordinate roundoff is scaled to the full interval, while independent voltage tolerances are unchanged.
Series L=1 H, shunt R=1000 ohm: H=1/(1+j*x). At x=1 and 2 the voltages are (1-j)/2 and (1-2j)/5.
Reversing an uncoupled coil preserves response; -2 V excitation multiplies the phasors by -2, giving -1+j at cutoff.
Series R=1000 ohm, L=1 H, C=1 uF with capacitor output: H=1/(1-x^2+j*x), x=omega/1000. At x=1 output=-j; at x=2 output=(-3-2j)/13.
Doubling L changes H to 1/(1-2*x^2+j*x): at original resonance (-1-j)/2, and at x=2 (-7-2j)/53.
Series uncoupled 0.25 H and 0.75 H sum to 1 H. The additional internal node does not change H=1/(1-x^2+j*x).
Resistor-fed parallel LC: H=1/(1+j*(x-1/x)). At x=0.5 output=(4+6j)/13; at x=1.5 output=(36-30j)/61. A unit-gain resonance lies at the interior sample.
Divider requirement: literal endpoint 10/3 V and all six sampled points satisfy [0,3.4] V.
RC gain H=1/(1+j*omega*RC) has magnitude sqrt(1/2) at cutoff and sqrt(1/5) at twice cutoff.
Explicit C=-2% variant: gain magnitudes are 1/sqrt(1+.98^2) and 1/sqrt(1+1.96^2), within the authored [.44,.72] bound.
From three to five RC time constants the native capacitor voltage is bounded by literal 5*(1-exp(-3)) and 5*(1-exp(-5)).
RC cutoff: Z=1000-j1000 ohm, I=(1+j)/2000 A and peak S=(1-j)/4000 VA. Nine logarithmic samples from cutoff to 100 cutoff.
RMS convention preserves voltage/current and doubles peak-reference average/reactive power.
Series RLC with RMS 1V: x=.1 gives input Z=1000-j9900 ohm, while x=10 gives 1000+j9900. Passive capacitor Q negative and inductor Q positive.
Four samples per octave from100 to900Hz ends at800Hz; no implicit sample at upper bound.
